nodes.body: { 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates } _James C. Kane_ has been developing a bunch this month, with [researching DIY dynamic gaussian splats and testing 1-to-4 camera capture methods like 4DAnyone and SharpML, played back with World Labs' SparkJS in real-time in the browser](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/james-c-kane_nvidiagtc-activity-7501663390977830912-2hLn), announced that [The Nanauts will be featured at Meta Connect](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/james-c-kane_proud-to-say-the-nanauts-will-be-featured-activity-7504194873625968640-IfJN), and is experimenting with [Slime sims running on zero-dependency WebGPU + WebXR](https://x.com/jamesckane/status/2104657221863047665)!
{ 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates } _LargerThanAverageGames_ made a fun [video to help promote Guild Legends' multiplayer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nw_6U9b6qs4)!

{ 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates } _Mike Breault_ has been demo-ing [Rubber Ducky Rampage!](https://prelaunch.breaultgames.com/) at game cons starting with GenCon in early August, then MoonCityCon (Springfield, MO) in mid-August, Who's Yer Con in Indy on 9/4-6/2026, TableTop Central (Savoy, IL) on 9/12-13/2026, Greyhawke Con (Murfreesboro, IL) on 9/19, and Archon (Collinsville, IL) on 10/2-4/2026. Coming up is MOBot's Best of Missouri show (St. Louis) on 10/9-11/2026, MadCon (Ft. Wayne, IN) on 10/23-25/2026, Meeple-A-Thon (Kansas City) on 11/6-8/2026, and Effing-Con (Effingham, IL) on 11/28/26!
{ 🎨 Visual Art } _Xain Russell_ is open for commissions! [Support their awesome work here](https://vgen.co/XainRussell)!
{ 🎨 Visual Art } _Noah Sliney_ showed off their awesome [Artstation filled with excellent character art](https://www.artstation.com/artwork/4NQ4mq)!

{ 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates } _Midnight Launch Games'_ Time To Rogue has been [updated with some major new features](https://midnightlaunchgames.com/games/timetorogue/)! The graphics have seen a total overhaul, the game now has a roguelike feature where certain floors let you choose a modifier that will make the rest of the game easier, some floors are boss floors, and there are now unlockable themes!
{ 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates } _Bloodrite Magicka_ released a video on [how to play their game](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NZeNt7eAwRg)!
{ 🕹️ Game Jam Releases } _TimConceivable!_ made art for [Diggin' Dragon](https://macrowdev.itch.io/diggin-dragon) for the [GBJAM 14](https://itch.io/jam/gbjam-14) game jam!
{ 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates } _Will Slama_ showed off [Unity realtime lights converted to vertex coloring](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=knxJ6iBY3K4)!

{ 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates } _Miniscule Games_ is working on a 3D kart racing game called [The Road Jess Karted](https://miniscule.itch.io/the-road-jess-karted?secret=2Lzznlmxewu7GLwLFvwuFoPwjQ) for Maryville University's Game Scripting class!

{!header} September brought in a gust of developer updates! STLGameDev represented St. Louis with our arcade launcher at the [Chicago Indie Games Showcase](https://www.indiecitygames.org/calendar/cigs-2026)! This upcoming month, we are hosting the [2026 Spooky Jam](https://itch.io/jam/stlgamedev-spooky-jam-2026) from October 1st through October 18th, and it's not too late to join! Check out the rules at the provided link. 
Have a creative October, everyone!
{ 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates } _Tony Wojnar_ is almost done with the [general layout of Glitch Ditch](https://bsky.app/profile/tonywojnar.bsky.social/post/3mwxzqfienk2b) for the upcoming game, Dribble 2!

{ 🎮 Game Releases } _Carol Mertz_ and game developer _Mary McKenzie_ created [Museum Memory](https://goo.gle/museum-memory), which is set inside a virtual museum gallery and requires a good memory and a sharp eye.
{ 🎼 Music Releases } _Goofy Gourd Studios_ released a [Battle Theme track](https://bsky.app/profile/goofygourds.bsky.social/post/3mwf2yygzhc2t) for an upcoming game!
{ 🎼 Music Releases } _Austin Miller_ worked on a couple of tracks for the newly released [Sealed Fortress](https://bsky.app/profile/austinmwav.com/post/3mux43afr2k23) game!

{ 🎮 Game Releases } _Alice Bucknell, Joseph Pleass, Ben West, Khalid Makshoush, Omar Khouri, and Nina Keith_ debuted Coyote Time, a game where players take on the role of a gig worker tasked with delivering to the City Museum. Play today on-site at the City Museum or online at [https://coyotetime.world/](https://coyotetime.world/).
{ 🎼 Music Releases } _Chrono Cards_ released their [soundtrack](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLD-6tiXUk050) on Youtube!

events.title: Spooky Jam 2026
events.description:
It's Spooky Season, which means it's time for another Spooky Jam! We encourage everyone to make games but we will accept creations of all kinds for this jam! Feel free to make a video game, board game, card game, visual art, comic, zine, song, music album, visual novel, poem, short story, sculpture... anything! 
For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see:https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/316821011/

events.title: October GameDev Social!
events.description:
Chat with fellow creators about making, playing, and admiring games! Talk about your game ideas and get inspired! Make friends and find collaborators. Our monthly hangout is open to EVERYONE!

For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/316205663
events.location: Schlafly Bottleworks, 7260 Southwest Ave, St. Louis, MO 63143, USA

events.title: Game Club: Toree Saturn
events.description:
Game Club is like a book club except we pick a game to play each month and then meet up to discuss it with a focus on game design. Our game for this month is Toree Saturn!

For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see:https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/316753984/
events.location: Sauce on the Side, 701 N New Ballas Rd, Creve Coeur, MO 63141, USA

events.title: October Game Audio Club
events.description:
If you’re into making video game music or sound design (or just curious) come hang out with us once a month! Doesn’t matter if you’re a pro or just starting out— everyone’s welcome. Just bring your love for game audio. Chill time where you can share your work, get feedback, or just vibe with people who love game audio. 
 
For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/316765267
events.location: St. Louis County Library - Clark Family Branch, 1640 S Lindbergh Blvd, St. Louis, MO 63131, USA

events.description: St. Louis County Library Clark Family branch is hosting casual work time for local game developers in the Creative Lab. Bring your project to work on and talk with other devs for feedback or fun. events.title: Share & Play: Game Playtesting!
events.description:
Join us for casual game playtesting! This is an opportunity for developers to share their progress, observe playtesting, and get feedback on their projects, and for local game enthusiasts to get their hands on new games, prototypes, and give helpful feedback. 
 
For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/314944382
